question: A child uses their parent’s smartphone to look up a funny picture. The child turns on the phone, opens the web browser (Chrome), searches for the funny picture, and then clicks on a link to the picture, which opens up Instagram. How many times did the child potentially come into contact with some form of an AI chatbot?

answers.answer: 0 – they did not potentially come into contact with some form of AI
2 – when they opened the phone; when they searched on Chrome
3 – when they opened the phone; when they searched on Chrome; when they opened TikTok
